items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 15:157:1
items.html:
And then the offspring emerges, included of male and female: the male from MA of BON, and the female from BON of BON. That is to say, that after this, when ZA goes and couples with the Nukva face to face for the birth of souls, behold, the souls that are from the discernment of Cain, which are all of them from the discernment of MA and BON of Ima — it is found that these males emerge from the discernment of MA of BON, and the females from BON of BON, that is, from the two aforementioned discernments that are in the first intercourse alone. However, for the souls that have a portion in the MA and BON of Aba, ZA bestows upon the Nukva from the discernment of MA of Aba as well. However, one must not err and suppose that the souls of the discernments of Cain actually emerge by means of the vessel and the Rucha of the first intercourse, for it is known that no woman conceives from the first intercourse, as above in Part 9. Rather, the intent is that these souls come from those two
discernments, MA and BON, that came in the vessel and the Rucha; but certainly they require a new coupling.
And you must know that after the sawing, ZA remaining entirely MA, that is, MA of AVI, and the Nukva entirely BON, that is, BON of AVI, it is likewise reckoned that at the time of the coupling for the need of the birth of souls, the male souls are born from the very substance of the building of the Partzuf of ZA, being either from the MA of Aba within him or from the MA of Ima within him; and the females are born from the very substance of the building of the Partzuf of the Nukva, that is, either from the BON of MA within her or from the BON of BON within her. And understand this well.
